authorization.reason: User explicitly requested stopping before stage 6; new explicit authorization is required.

diagnostic_only.reason: Belém pilot already inspected; cannot be treated as unseen validation or test.

reservation_policy.if_previously_inspected: quarantine affected cases; revise protocol version before fitting and reserve new untouched periods
reservation_policy.test_opening: Only after candidate parameters, code, source hashes and validation decision are frozen under later authorization.

initial_adjustment_collection.selection: Fixed quarterly windows for seasonal coverage; no selection by favorable model results.
initial_adjustment_collection.adequacy: Diagnostic expansion only; no claim of national representativeness or sufficient severe events.

station.role: meteorological observation; raw official files and station identity must be verified

target.meteorological_reference: Frozen reference-v1 thresholds applied to a separately identified observation source.

metrics.no_support: null/indeterminate; never count as successful detection or zero error

uncertainty_plan.method: paired moving-block bootstrap on calendar dates, all locations and leads from each sampled date kept together
uncertainty_plan.caveat: Technical design choices pending scientific review; discontinuous windows must be resampled separately, never bridged; sparse-event or degenerate intervals yield inconclusive results.

future_acceptance_gates.high_recall: No negative paired difference versus R0 in the primary estimate; uncertainty must rule out deterioration before declaring gain.
future_acceptance_gates.false_alarm_ratio: No positive paired difference versus R0 in the primary estimate; uncertainty must rule out deterioration before declaring gain.
future_acceptance_gates.numeric_calibration: MAE and RMSE must not increase; require a paired interval strictly below zero for at least one prespecified primary metric to claim improvement.
future_acceptance_gates.strata: Report every prespecified stratum; any harmful or unsupported critical stratum blocks automatic acceptance.
future_acceptance_gates.sample_sufficiency: Scientific reviewer must prespecify event counts and precision requirements before fitting; absent severe-event support means inconclusive.

freeze_policy: This version freezes the technical design only. Amendments require a new identifier and reason recorded before outcomes are examined; no silent overwrite after fitting. Dataset, targets and code must be independently frozen before stage 6.
